extraction.notes: IRT reports FFO and CFFO (core) only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Starting line is consolidated net income ($8,172), before NCI allocation, consistent with the FFO build. Share count uses 'Weighted-average shares and units outstanding' for three months ended June 30, 2025 (239,438,276), the CFFO denominator; 68,001/239,438 = $0.28 reproduces reported FFO and CFFO per share. Diluted weighted-average shares of 234,131,752 would give ~$0.29 and do not reproduce the reported figure. Loss on impairment and prepayment gains/penalties, loss on extinguishment and other loss are zero for Q2 2025 (printed as dashes). Recurring capex is from the Capital Expenditures narrative on printed page 4 (seq 6), stated in millions as $10.5 million, recorded as 10,500 thousands; it is rounded and scoped to the total portfolio as printed. Figures from the trailing five quarters schedule (printed page 10); the three-month and six-month schedule on printed page 11 agrees for the Q2 2025 column.
